overview_description.description: Arabian Robotics is a designer and developer of solutions for various industrial applications. They provide competitive robotic inspection and non-destructive testing services that include non destructive testing, pipe inspection, tank inspection, and vessel inspection. Arabian Robotics continuously develops highly effective technologies in collaboration with key international partners to provide its clients with trustworthy and affordable inspection solutions and services.

product.name: SAIR Inspection Robot
product.description: A robotic system for ultrasonic thickness testing, visual inspection, and gas sensing of steel assets in industrial environments.

product.name: Pipe Inspection Service
product.description: Automated robotic inspection service for nondestructive testing of pipes and elbows, including ultrasonic thickness measurement and visual inspection.

product.name: Tank Inspection Service
product.description: Robotic nondestructive testing service for inspecting tank shells and large vessels to assess structural integrity.

product.name: Vessel Inspection Service
product.description: Robotic inspection service for nondestructive testing of industrial vessels, including ultrasonic and visual assessments.

product.name: Automation Services for Inspection
product.description: Automation solutions integrating robotic systems for nondestructive testing and inspection tasks in industrial settings.
